memory_atoms.title: A correct route name is not enough
memory_atoms.rule: A response is incomplete when the planner selects the correct route but executes only a broad semantic search. The route-specific source must be attempted and its result reported.
examples: An OCR route must inspect OCR records rather than only semantic page similarity.
A navigation route should preserve a matching visual page as a navigation lead.

memory_atoms.title: Keep matching navigation leads useful
memory_atoms.rule: When direct proof is absent, a matching visual, OCR, table, candidate, or semantic page may still be reported as a clearly labeled navigation lead. Do not discard a correct page merely because it is not proof.
examples: Page 84 may be reported as a visual navigation lead for the exact requested part.
The page lead must not be described as approval or nomenclature proof.

memory_atoms.title: OCR answers require OCR records
memory_atoms.rule: An OCR answer must distinguish actual stored OCR text, engine, confidence, and page from semantic or visual page leads. Semantic similarity is not recovered OCR text.
examples: Report the stored OCR snippet and confidence when present.
When no OCR record is resolved, say so and list pages for retry.

memory_atoms.title: Broad aggregation needs coverage metadata
memory_atoms.rule: A broad entity aggregation must report unique pages, documents, evidence-family counts, scan scope, capping, and whether coverage is complete for the current indexed artifact set.
examples: Two semantic hits alone do not establish every-page coverage.
State that indexed-artifact coverage is not the same as all external manuals.

memory_atoms.title: Keep decomposed claims separate in the answer
memory_atoms.rule: After decomposing a multi-question request, preserve a separate status and evidence bucket for every claim through rendering. Do not collapse the answer to whichever evidence type happened to return first.
examples: A figure can be guidance-found while nomenclature remains unresolved.
No authority evidence means the replacement claim is not confirmed even when identity guidance exists.

memory_atoms.title: Attempt source-trace resolution before final fallback
memory_atoms.rule: Before returning a guidance-only fallback for an exact entity, attempt to resolve existing local source-citation, OCR, table, visual, and graph artifacts. Promote only records explicitly marked citation-ready or source-trace-ready.
examples: A source-citation row with page, field, and value may become direct evidence.
An unmarked OCR or visual row remains guidance.
